sentences.text: Rishi Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2025

Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:5374
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 482 Bnss No. - 12255 of 2024
Applicant :- Rishi Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.

Heard Sri Pankaj Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the State and
perused the material placed on record.

2.  The instant anticipatory bail application has been moved by the applicant for enlarging him on bail in Case Crime No. 470 of 2024, under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 470, 120-B I.P.C., P.S. Sadar Bazar, District- Agra, during pendency of trial.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant is not the owner of the said land but he was authorized by Director of the said company to execute the sale deed in favour of the buyers in respect of the property of the said company.

Applicant has no concern about the loan and property Rishi Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31795158/
1 in question and also he is not beneficiary in any manner.

entities.text: Rishi Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant is not involved in the present case.
No charge-sheet has been filed and investigation is under progress.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would co-operate with the investigation.
Applicant has definite apprehension of his arrest by the police.
4. Learned AGA opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicant with the contention that the applicant is not entitled for anticipatory bail as prima facie case is made out.
The apprehension of the applicant is not founded on any material on record, only on the basis of imaginary fear, the anticipatory bail cannot be granted.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC Online SC 98
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.

8. The Investigating Officer is directed to conclude the investigation of the present case in accordance with law expeditiously preferably within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order independently without being prejudice by any observation made by this Court while considering and deciding the present anticipatory bail application of the applicant.
9. The present anticipatory bail application stands allowed.
Order Date :- 10.1.2025
